title: Beyond Field Accuracy: Two-Axis Diagnosis of Inverse-PINN Parameter Error
abstract: arXiv:2608.15373v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Inverse physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) can reconstruct a field accurately while returning an incorrect physical parameter. We introduce a two-axis post-training diagnosis that separates finite-sample resolution under a specified observation-and-estimation protocol from the signed parameter preference encoded by the final learned field and residual metric. The first axis repeatedly fits noisy observations with a matched forward estimator. At known synthetic truth, the second freezes the field and residual view and computes a local score displacement toward a nearby residual-profile minimum. Endpoint consistency then tests whether joint training delivers that preference under the same final view. Across three synthetic one-dimensional, scalar-parameter PDEs, matched-forward mean absolute relative error ranges from 2.34 percent to 17.46 percent. translated_title: 超越场精度：逆物理信息神经网络参数误差的双轴诊断
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15373v1 公告类型：新 摘要：逆物理信息神经网络（PINNs）能够准确重建场，但可能返回不正确的物理参数。我们引入了一种训练后双轴诊断方法，该方法将指定观测与估计协议下的有限样本分辨率与最终学习场和残差度量编码的带符号参数偏好分离开来。第一轴使用匹配的正向估计器重复拟合带噪声的观测数据。在已知的合成真值下，第二轴冻结场和残差视图，并计算朝向邻近残差曲线最小值的局部分数位移。端点一致性随后测试联合训练是否在相同最终视图下实现该偏好。在三个合成的一维标量参数偏微分方程中，匹配正向平均绝对相对误差范围为2.34%至17.46%。位移轨迹追踪冻结轮廓最小值，跨越锁定种子、架构和...
tldr: 本文提出一种双轴诊断方法，用于分离逆PINN中有限样本分辨率与参数偏好，从而解释场精度高但参数错误的现象。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-axis diagnostic method to separate finite-sample resolution from parameter preference in inverse PINNs, explaining why field accuracy can be high while parameter estimates are incorrect.
